description: Searches one country's official company register by name and returns registered companies in one consistent shape: number, legal name, status, legal form, dates, town and postcode, and a link to the register entry. Covers GB, NO, FR, FI, CZ, SK, IE, AU and the worldwide LEI register. Companies only, no directors or contact details.

country.description: Register to search: gb, no, fr, fi, cz, sk, ie, au, or global for the LEI register.

limit.description: Most companies to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

name: search_company_registry
title: Search an official company registry
